title: Mobile Idle RPG Progression Tree
summary: Portrait progression screen for a mobile idle RPG with upgrades, rewards, rarity, and ethical retention cadence.
prompt: Design a portrait mobile game progression screen for {argument name="game_title" default="Starfall Companions"}. Show hero growth nodes, idle reward claim, crafting unlocks, rarity colors, milestone chest cadence, daily quest reminder, and optional fair monetization slot. Prioritize one-thumb reach, large touch targets, readable numbers, colorblind-safe rarity states, and session-based clarity. Avoid storefront clutter; the screen must feel like progression, not a sales funnel.
